project_type: Marketing website (SSR). TanStack Start v1 + React 19 + Vite 8 + Tailwind v4, deployed to Railway (Nitro node-server). Connected to Lovable.
language: TypeScript / TSX + a single global CSS file (src/styles.css, ~2240 lines)
build_system: npm scripts over Vite. overrides.rolldown pinned. engines.node ^20.19 || >=22.12.
test_framework: vitest (jsdom) + @testing-library/react. Content-shape tests live in src/lib/*.test.ts (site-data.test.ts asserts services==4, projects>=16, metrics==4, technologies==8, industries>=15).
verification_instructions: Repo CI gate is exactly: unset NODE_OPTIONS && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build. Then a manual scroll-smoothness + prefers-reduced-motion pass on a real device (flagged unverified in headless preview per roadmap.md).
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/assets/images.ts is generated by `npm run images` (scripts/optimize-images.mjs) and must NOT be hand-edited; src/routeTree.gen.ts is generated by the router plugin. Neither is being changed in this task.
setup_instructions: npm install then npm run dev (port 8080). NOTE: sandbox is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, npm registry unreachable, so node_modules cannot be installed and none of typecheck/lint/test/build/dev can be run here. Work correct-by-construction.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network: npm install/ci HANGS, node_modules absent. Cannot run typecheck/lint/test/build/vite/playwright to completion in-sandbox. Also NODE_OPTIONS has a broken preload (proxy-bootstrap.js) so every node/npm command MUST be prefixed with `unset NODE_OPTIONS &&`. All verification is deferred to CI / preview deploy after push.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: connected to Lovable; do NOT rewrite published history (no force-push/rebase/amend/squash of pushed commits); keep the branch in a working state; commits sync back to Lovable. Prettier (.prettierrc) + ESLint (eslint.config.js) enforced by CI - match formatting exactly. CSP is defined in src/server.ts; do not add new external script/font/API hosts.
key_patterns: MAIN IS A SUPERSET of the test design handoff. Main already implements: scroll progress bar, condensing header (.is-condensed), count-up metrics (Metric sub-component), infinite tech marquee (.tech-band-track duplicated), pinned services showcase, and an editorial asymmetric projects grid - all wired through a bespoke ScrollFocusStack sticky-chapter motion system that the plain test handoff does NOT have. Motion convention: rAF-gated scroll/resize listeners that early-return under prefers-reduced-motion:reduce AND (max-width:900px) for the heavier effects; lerp-toward-target smoothing (current += (target-current)*factor). All copy/data is in src/lib/site-data.ts (16 projects, 4 services, 8 technologies, 19 industries, 4 metrics, 4 values, 4 process steps, 5 faqs). Assets mapped in src/assets/images.ts (generated) with intrinsic width/height spread onto to prevent CLS. Design tokens (colors --raspberry/--lavender/--sky/--mint/--butter/--ink/--line, fonts --font-display/--font-sans, type scale --display-*/--text-*, --soft-shadow, --ease-out, --section-gap, --heading-gap, --header-h) all already defined in :root - DO NOT redefine.
relevant_files: src/styles.css (all visual work happens here; ~2240 lines)
src/components/pinned-services-showcase.tsx (image object-fit cover vs test's contain - key fitting decision)
src/components/content-sections.tsx (MetricsStrip, ProjectsGrid, ServicesGrid, TechnologyBand, IndustryGrid, ValuesGrid, ProcessGrid, FounderStory, FaqSection)
src/components/site-shell.tsx (SiteHeader condense, PageLayout reveal observer, SiteFooter)
src/lib/site-data.ts (SOURCE OF TRUTH for content - do not remove any)
src/lib/site-data.test.ts (guards content counts - must keep passing)
directory_structure: src/routes/*.tsx = file-based routes (index, projects, services, about-us, contact-us, privacy-policy, terms-of-service, ai-dev-automation-playbook[-form], __root). src/components = section + shell components. src/components/ui = radix-based primitives (accordion,button,input,textarea). src/lib = data + form logic + tests. src/assets/original = source art; src/assets/images.ts = generated manifest. Single global stylesheet src/styles.css. Reference-only design handoff lives on origin/test (access via `git show origin/test:<path>`), NOT merged.
reconciliation_notes: Diff of main's 3 shared components vs origin/test reference versions: (1) scroll-progress.tsx = IDENTICAL. (2) projects-showcase-grid.tsx = main is a superset (adds decoding/eager-loading + limit optional). (3) pinned-services-showcase.tsx = main DIVERGED to drive progress off the ScrollFocusStack .motion-stage instead of per-row rects (main's is more integrated). Test styles-additions.css uses .pinned-services-visual img { object-fit: contain } with note 'these illustrations carry built-in whitespace; cover crops/zooms oddly' - main currently uses object-fit: cover, which is the kind of awkward crop the user is complaining about. This is the single most important test idea to ADOPT. Test's condensing-header + marquee CSS = already present/better in main.
